parameters.help_en:
The policy ID.
Call the [DescribeSoarSubscribedStrategy](~~DescribeSoarSubscribedStrategy~~) operation to obtain this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
策略ID。
调用[DescribeSoarSubscribedStrategy](~~DescribeSoarSubscribedStrategy~~)接口可以获取该参数
parameters.name: strategy_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the policy task
parameters.name: strategy_task_name

parameters.example: 漏洞自动化批量修复策略
parameters.help_en: The policy name. Set the value to: Automated Batch Vulnerability Fix Policy
parameters.help_zh: 策略名称。固定取值：漏洞自动化批量修复策略
parameters.name: strategy_name

parameters.help_en:
The parameter information of the policy. The value is a string in JSONArray format. The following items are included:

Vulnerability configuration item. Valid values:
name: vluList
associationProperty: sasAllVul
value: the basic information of the vulnerability.

Snapshot configuration item. Valid values:
name: snapshotConfig
associationProperty: snapshotConfig
value: the storage time information.

Notification configuration. Valid values:
name: notifyConfig
associationProperty: notifyConfig
value: the configuration information of email or DingTalk notifications
parameters.help_zh:
策略的参数信息。JSONArray格式的字符串，含义：

漏洞配置项。取值：
name：vluList
associationProperty：sasAllVul
value：漏洞的基本信息

快照配置项。取值
name：snapshotConfig
associationProperty：snapshotConfig
value：存储时间信息

通知配置
name：notifyConfig
associationProperty：notifyConfig
value：邮件或者钉钉的配置信息
parameters.name: strategy_task_params

parameters.help_en: The planned execution timestamp of the policy task. Unit: milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 策略任务计划执行时间戳，单位为毫秒
parameters.name: strategy_task_plan_exe_time
